reason: A named independent lab with the report for my exact batch behind the QR code is the thing I usually have to dig for, and bisglycinate with no oxide and a stated dose is what I look for. At the $24.99 launch price and with a money-back guarantee I would try one box, not two.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. It is a brand with no reviews yet, so I would open the lab report and check that the batch number and the dose really match before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report was missing, did not match the batch number, or the price stayed at $29.99 with no launch discount, I would pass.
